result.title: Reconstruct What You Can: Distractor-free 4D Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: Dynamic reconstruction from casual video must preserve valid subject motion while suppressing transient occluders, shadows, and volumetric effects. Existing methods either suppress valid motion through static-scene assumptions or model all observations jointly, producing ghosting and unstable geometry. We introduce ReCan-GS, a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework that separates coherent scene content from inconsistent observations. It derives a Jacobian-based deformation-sensitivity score from the learned deformation field, using it as an empirical proxy for reconstruction ambiguity. The score guides separation into dynamic Core Gaussians and per-view Distractor Gaussians, or post-hoc pruning of sensitive Core Gaussians. The same criterion supports removal of spatial occluders, photometric artifacts, and evolving smoke or fog without masks, pretrained segmenters, or medium-specific supervision. Experiments on synthetic and real dynamic scenes and synthetic smoke/fog scenes demonstrate its usefulness across the evaluated distractor regimes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReCan-GS，从 4D 高斯的形变场导出 Jacobian 敏感性分数作为重建歧义的经验代理，据此把场景分离为动态 Core Gaussians 与逐视角 Distractor Gaussians，无需 mask 或分割模型即可抑制瞬态遮挡物、阴影与烟雾。
AI.relevance_reason: 用敏感性评分区分「一致内容」与「视角特异观测」的状态分解与后验剪枝思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中如何把任务相关 latent 与视角/证据噪声分离、并据此做状态贡献分配，其可迁移性需读原文确认。
